free_tier.stated: No free tier. RTX 4090 rental is USD 0.40 per hour, billed per minute, and the home page states 'Indicative starting rates. Final prices are set by individual verified providers and update in real time on the rental dashboard.' An account starts with a USD 5 minimum top-up. Only RTX 4090 and RTX 5090 are offered; H100, A100, L40S and L4 are not listed.
